Hi Karina, I am Mike. I help companies with Instagram. Can I ask about your account?
Of course, Mike. I post videos about aircraft for my company.
Great. How often do you post?
I usually post three times a week. I always post on Monday.
Good. Do you write the caption in English?
No, I never write in English. My captions are in Portuguese.
Many of your followers are from other countries. I always say: write a short caption in English too.
Good idea. People sometimes write a comment in English, but I do not always answer.
Answer every comment. People share the content of a brand that talks to them.
OK. This week I will write my first caption in English!

Hello, I am Mike, and today I have three tips for your business on Instagram. First, post often. I usually post four times a week, and I never stop for a long time. Second, write a good caption. A short caption is always better than a long caption. Third, talk to your followers. I always answer comments in the morning, and I sometimes share photos from my clients. Your brand is not only your product. Your brand is the way you talk to people. Good luck!

Hi everyone, I am Sofia. I sell private jets in Texas, and Instagram is a big part of my business. I post a new video every Tuesday and every Friday. I usually film the aircraft at the airport in the morning, because the light is beautiful. I sometimes post photos of happy clients, but I always ask them first. I never post prices on Instagram. When a follower is interested, I send a message, and we talk. Last year, three of my clients found me on Instagram.

First, Karina films a new video of the aircraft. Then, she writes a short caption in English. Next, she posts the video on Monday morning. After that, followers write comments and share the video. Finally, Karina answers every comment.
I always answer comments in the morning.
I never post prices on Instagram.
I usually post three times a week.
